propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets across their lint, pip-audit, and test jobs, creating drift risk that test_ci_workflow_parity.py must police via string comparison

a single reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml (workflow_call) should consolidate the shared lint+pip-audit+test jobs with checkout parameterized by gerrit-refspec, eliminating copy-sync drift by construction
test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must both delegate to _build-and-test.yml; gerrit-verify's single reusable-call job named build-and-test still satisfies vote needs and external job dependencies

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five functions must be rewritten to assert delegation to _build-and-test.yml and validate reusable content (gate existence, script scope, pre-commit SKIP, optionality contract) rather than comparing inline caller copies
test_workflow_names.py must add _build-and-test.yml to its locked naming table and verify workflow_call input schema via actionlint pre-merge
